execution_trace.intent: Search for tactile-friendly exhibits in the American Wing using department and accessibility keywords.
Fetch detailed metadata for each tactile exhibit to confirm accessibility tags and physical location within the museum.
Geocode the Metropolitan Museum's main address to obtain base coordinates for proximity searches.
Search for accessible restrooms near the museum using the resolved coordinates and 'wheelchair accessible restroom' keyword.
Search for accessible entrances near the museum using the same base coordinates and 'accessible entrance' keyword.
Search for universally recognized accessibility icons suitable for representing tactile exhibits, restrooms, and entrances.
Check platform adoption metrics for top candidate icons to ensure cross-platform recognizability in mobile apps.

trace.user_request: I'm planning a visit to The Met in New York next Tuesday. Find what special exhibitions are open that day, locate the nearest subway station, and check if it'll rain so I know whether to bring an umbrella.

execution_trace.intent: Identify available departments to scope exhibition search.
Search for current special exhibitions using department context.
Geocode The Met's address to obtain coordinates.
Find nearby subway stations using The Met's coordinates.
Get detailed info (e.g., entrance location) for the closest subway station.
Resolve 'New York' into a weather location ID for forecast lookup.
Fetch weather forecast for next Tuesday using resolved location.

trace.user_request: I'm planning a visit to The Met tomorrow afternoon. Find me the nearest subway station, check if there are any weather alerts for that time, and tell me if the museum has any special exhibitions on Impressionist art.

execution_trace.intent: Search for special exhibitions related to Impressionist art currently on display.
Fetch details of one key Impressionist exhibition found in step 1 to confirm relevance.
Geocode The Met's address to obtain precise coordinates for proximity search.
Find the nearest subway stations to The Met using its coordinates.
Retrieve detailed info (e.g., entrance location, accessibility) for the closest subway station.
Resolve 'The Met' location into a weather-compatible location ID for forecast lookup.
Fetch afternoon weather forecast for tomorrow at The Met’s location to check for alerts or precipitation.
